acceptance: pypi accepts deployments only from v* tags
test-pypi has a deployment policy that still admits the rehearsal
description: The `pypi` GitHub deployment environment requires the owner's approval but has no deployment branch or tag policy, and `test-pypi` has no protection rules at all (checked 2026-10-23). A run of the registered publishing workflow on any ref can therefore deploy to either environment: after approval for pypi, immediately for test-pypi. Restrict `pypi` to `v*` tags and give `test-pypi` a policy that still admits the release rehearsal (see dlv2-52a-testpypi-rehearsal). This is an owner-only repository setting; record the new configuration in docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md and, if the settings drift check covers environments, its expected values.
